title: Addresses are read as RFC 5322 defines them, including obsolete and commented forms
statement: Mail SHALL read the address fields of a received message (From, Sender, Reply-To, To, Cc, Bcc) into mailboxes and groups as RFC 5322 3.4 and 4.4 define them: display names unquoted, comments and folding white space removed, routes dropped, empty list elements skipped, and groups kept with their members. A domain compares without regard to case; a local part compares exactly.
